extracted.intended_audience: marketers, PR professionals, and media-relations practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for planning, producing, and distributing Video News Releases (VNRs) that secure media pickup and audience engagement. Covers components (b-roll, interviews, narrative), production and editorial choices, timing, and distribution strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include b-roll footage
rubrics_metrics.description: A VNR typically includes b-roll footage — supplemental visuals that illustrate the story and give journalists ready-to-use clips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture vibrant, usable visuals that illustrate key moments (e.g., event highlights, interactions). B-roll should be edited into concise packages that require minimal additional editing by newsrooms. Example: Peppa Pig VNR used vibrant event b-roll to drive pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include interviews with spokespeople (soundbites)
rubrics_metrics.description: VNRs should include interviews with spokespeople to provide quotable soundbites and context for the visuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare spokespersons with key messages and questions; use pre-prepared questions to elicit clear responses. Authentic, candid answers (even shot on a phone) can be effective — Jill Renick example used iPhone-recorded responses to powerful effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear narrative aligned with brand messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: The VNR should have a clear narrative that aligns with your products, services, and overall brand messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outline the key message up front and identify the visuals and interview moments needed to support that narrative. Whether the story is celebratory or sensitive, ensure every element reinforces the brand-aligned storyline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan your narrative (pre-production planning)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outline key messages, identify necessary visuals, and plan how the story will unfold before filming.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a scripted narrative or shot list to ensure you capture the visuals and soundbites required. Planning reduces wasted footage and makes post-production faster and more focused.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on production value (visual/audio quality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the video is clear, visually appealing and easy to edit for different formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture high-quality visuals and clean audio so clips are broadcast-ready. That said, high production value is not always required — raw, authentic footage can outperform polished production when the story is emotionally resonant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide ready-to-use content for journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: VNRs should be polished and immediately usable by newsrooms, minimizing their need to do additional editing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edit packages concisely with clean soundbites and b-roll cues. Journalists are more likely to use a VNR that slots directly into broadcasts or online stories with minimal work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pair the VNR with a detailed press release
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute the VNR alongside a detailed written press release to provide context and supporting facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a complementary press release that summarizes the story, provides quotes, background, and contact information. The combination increases the likelihood of pickup and accurate coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribute strategically / targeted media outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Send the VNR to targeted media outlets and newsrooms most likely to cover the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor your pitch and recipient list by outlet type, geography, and beat. Strategic distribution increases relevance and the chance outlets will use the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor content for platforms and formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Adapt and format the VNR for TV, social media, and online platforms to maximize reach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create cutdowns and platform-specific edits (e.g., square or vertical formats for social) and provide assets sized for different channels so the story works everywhere it’s distributed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fast turnaround / speed of execution
rubrics_metrics.description: Timely editing and distribution can significantly increase media pickup and viral potential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for rapid post-event turnaround when appropriate — example: Peppa Pig VNR edited into a four-minute package within two hours, which helped nationwide pickup. Fast delivery makes the story timely and more attractive to newsrooms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise length and edit
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep VNR packages concise and focused so they’re easy for newsrooms to use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short, tightly edited packages (example given: a four-minute b-roll package) are more likely to be used and repurposed. Avoid overly long footage that requires heavy editing by journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional authenticity and storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Authentic, emotionally resonant storytelling can be more compelling than highly polished production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For sensitive or human-interest stories, prioritize authenticity and voice; raw footage and genuine answers can increase pickup and audience impact (Jill Renick case).

rubrics_metrics.name: Respectful handling of sensitive subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: When covering crises or tragedies, minimize burden on subjects and tell the story respectfully.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare questions thoughtfully, use consented footage, avoid exploiting grief, and limit intrusion on families — the Jill Renick example highlights minimizing burden while telling a respectful story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versatility of use (events to crisis response)
rubrics_metrics.description: VNRs should be usable for a range of objectives from event highlights to crisis communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design packages that can serve multiple needs (broadcast, social, online) and think in advance about the story’s purpose — celebration, awareness, crisis response — so the VNR fits that role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage media and audiences / expand visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: A successful VNR should engage both media outlets and target audiences, expanding visibility across platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use compelling visuals, clear soundbites, and platform-tailored edits to increase audience engagement and make it easy for media to run the story. VNRs that perform well on social can amplify earned media coverage.
